short_format_reason: Focused case study of Caribbean societies before 1492; neighboring studies concern different regions and periods.
description: Surveys Caribbean societies before 1492 through maritime connections, settlement, agriculture, material culture, and ancient DNA. Distinguishes evidence for population movement from claims about language, identity, or uniform island cultures.
